title: Streaming Running Median Tracker

visible.label: Odd and even stream length medians
visible.inputDisplay: add(5), median()==5.0, add(15), median()==10.0, add(1), median()==5.0
visible.script:
m = MedianTracker()
m.add(5)
assert m.median() == 5.0
m.add(15)
assert m.median() == 10.0
m.add(1)
assert m.median() == 5.0

visible.label: Empty tracker median raises ValueError

hidden.label: Descending insertion sequence
hidden.script:
m = MedianTracker()
out = []
for x in [10, 8, 6, 4, 2]:
    m.add(x); out.append(m.median())
assert out == [10.0, 9.0, 8.0, 7.0, 6.0]

hidden.label: Duplicate identical values
Negative values supported accurately
Median always returned as float
hidden.script:
m = MedianTracker(); m.add(4)
assert isinstance(m.median(), float)

hidden.label: O(log n) two-heap speed over 9,000 zig-zag stream additions
hidden.inputDisplay: Add 9,000 alternating integers and query median every step
hidden.script:
m = MedianTracker()
for i in range(1, 9001):
    m.add(-i if i % 2 else i)
    _ = m.median()
assert m.median() == 0.5

hints: Use two heaps: `low` (a max-heap simulated by pushing negated `-num`) holding the smaller half, and `high` (min-heap) holding the larger half.
Maintain invariant: `len(low) == len(high)` OR `len(low) == len(high) + 1`, and every element in `low <= every element in high`.

Pseudocode:
  push -num to low, pop max (-heappop(low)) and push to high
  if len(high) > len(low): push -heappop(high) to low
  median: -low[0] if len(low) > len(high) else (-low[0] + high[0]) / 2.0
